title: You Do Not Need Thousands To Start Investing

beats.say: You do not need thousands to invest: some brokers let you start with one dollar.
beats.visual: a single paper coin standing on the first rung of a tiny paper ladder, bold layers

beats.say: Many people think you need a pile of cash before you can begin.
beats.visual: a huge paper mountain of coins towering over a small paper silhouette on a cliff edge

beats.say: That belief comes from account minimums and the price of whole shares.
beats.visual: a paper wall with a giant round door shaped like a pie, layered shadows

beats.say: Fidelity has a zero dollar minimum to open a brokerage account.
beats.visual: a wide open paper gate with cream light spilling out and a coin as its hinge

beats.say: It also lets you buy fractional shares of more than seven thousand stocks and funds, from as little as one dollar.
beats.visual: a paper pie cut into thin wedges, one wedge lifted by tweezers, layered

beats.say: Commissions on US stock and ETF trades are zero there too.
beats.visual: a paper balance with a feather on one side and tall paper coins on the other

beats.say: Other brokers offer similar features, so compare a few before you choose.
beats.visual: three paper doors side by side in different colors, layered drop shadows

beats.say: Here is the part nobody tells you. Starting small can build the habit of investing regularly.
beats.visual: a paper sprout growing from a paper coin in cream soil, bold layers

beats.say: The honest catch: investing can lose money, and small amounts carry the same risk for each dollar.
beats.visual: a paper roller coaster track dipping sharply with a tiny paper car at the top

beats.say: Fund fees, taxes and risk apply at any size, and nothing here says what to buy.
beats.visual: a paper umbrella over a small stack of paper coins in layered paper rain

beats.say: Keep an emergency fund first, because investments can fall when you need the cash.
beats.visual: a paper padlock and a paper key resting side by side on cream paper

beats.say: So the myth says wait until you have thousands. The truth is, access is easy. Understanding the risk is the real work.
beats.visual: a cut-paper mountain trail with a tiny flag at the summit

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: a cut-paper sun rising over layered paper hills
